text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Happy Valentine's.âª
I bet everyone was dying to see me by now, right?

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting~! Thanks, Heart♡
What did you make for me this year~?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
They're conversation heart cookies!
I wrote a message on each one,
so make sure to check them out♪

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-shaped cookies are so cute~♡
Mine says 'CUTIE PIE' on it!
Does that mean I'm a cutie? Oh, stop it~♡"

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend C
text_block_list.text:
"Mine said 'LOVE YOU'~♡
—Hey, hey, Heart, what message are you giving to Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufu, but of course—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm...
What should I do...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Giving a "BE MINE" to my Trainer...
That's a no-go, right? Probably.
His eyes would pop right out of his head.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
To begin with... is it really okay
to give cookies like everyone else?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: âAh, it's Heart-san!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The cookies were super delicious~!
I was really happy that it said "RESPECT", too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that was a heartfelt message.
I'm the one who's happy you took it to heart!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪
Hey, hey, what did you write for Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's just it, Craft.
I'm agonizing over what to write.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I didn't hesitate for a second on the message to my friend, though...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-san is... that's unusual.
...She's taking this super seriously, huh."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Hup.
(Plump!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Heart-san is always
pushing me forward, so... this is my way of giving back!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Go for it, Heart-san!
—Bold and cool, just like always!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That's it!
Thank you, Craft!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: True to myself, boldly... Yes, exactly! I should just drop a stitch or two!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's Heart-san for you!
If there's anything I can help with, just let me know!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—If you don't mind...
would you like our help too?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I happened to overhear.
Still... I would really love to help if I can.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Cesario-san handles the recipe, I'll take the steps, Craft-san brings the ideas... and once Heart-san pours her feelings into it—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Don't you think this will complete
the ultimate Valentine's Day?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...My Trainer sure is lucky.
Having the strongest team made for them."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Okay, it's our Youth Valentine's Edition!
With everyone's help……
I'll shoot straight through Trainer's heart!"
One evening, I received a message from Daring Heart and headed to the designated meeting spot—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Over here!
choice_data_list: You went out of your way to call me here, what's up?
You went out of your way to call me here—what's up?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, don't you understand?
Today is the absolute most special day!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Or does that mean
you weren't expecting anything from me?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Seriously?
Well, it can't be helped—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's Day!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That's right!
You finally understand."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I prepared a special cake
just for you, you know?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It might look simple on the outside,
but the inside is red velvet... completely crimson.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "It's modeled after my burning heart. Plus, Craft and the others helped out! Pretty super special, don't you think?"
choice_data_list: Thanks so much for going out of your way...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's too early to celebrate.
For the finishing touch... could you hold this?

After handing me the cake,
she took out a red chocolate pen and started writing something on top. Then—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Finished!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—The message for you is
'SWEET HEART.'

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: It means... "My cute darling"!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that innocent reaction!
See? Isn't it just perfect?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I wonder. As for whether I'm teasing you or not...
—that's entirely up to how you take it, you know? Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—The message for you is...
'MY ONE AND ONLY.'

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: To me, you are...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Someone who is incredibly important, deeply meaningful,
and immensely valuable.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...is what that means.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You're just so humble.
I bet you have days where you lose confidence too, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever that happens, just remember this message.
And if you still can't believe it, will you call for me?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I shall use every word at my command to tell you just how "special" you truly are.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: You really don't need to thank me!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's what you're always...
doing for me, after all.
